name: Dreadnought
description: Strikes prepare a [dark-red]broadside cannon[/dark-red], up to [effect:cannons][dark-gray]2-4 cannons[/dark-gray][/effect]. Thrown hits signal each cannon to fire an explosive cannonball [effect:enemies][dark-gray]towards enemies[/dark-gray][/effect] in the direction of the throw.

effects.explanation: Each enemy is targeted by up to 1 cannon. If your cannons outnumber enemies, additional cannons will fire in a random spread towards the group.
